items.title: Why is AI generated language so hard to understand?

extra.evidence: There is a widespread sense that AI-generated text has recently become harder to understand. In this study, we investigate a set of psycholinguistic features that are known to correlate with human processing difficulty (e.g., object relative clauses, long syntactic dependencies, low-frequency n-grams). Using a novel corpus of AI-generated text across diverse domains, we find that AI models use these difficult features more often than paraphrases generated by round-trip translation. Compared with human writing, all nine frontier and near-frontier models use more inanimate subjects with animate verbs and more low-frequency n-grams, and most also use longer dependencies, more stacked nouns, and more reduced object relatives in conversation; we also demonstrate substantial variation across mo…

items.title: The foolishness of "natural language programming" (1978)

extra.evidence: On the foolishness of "natural language programming" . Since the early days of automatic computing we have had people that have felt it as a shortcoming that programming required the care and accuracy that is characteristic for the use of any formal symbolism. They blamed the mechanical slave for its strict obedience with which it carried out its given instructions, even if a moment's thought would have revealed that those instructions contained an obvious mistake. "But a moment is a long time, and thought is a painful process." (A.E.Housman). They eagerly hoped and waited for more sensible machinery that would refuse to embark on such nonsensical activities as a trivial clerical error evoked at the time. items.title: 刘铁岩、诺奖、图灵奖得主等嘉宾共话AI的下一个十年：Transformer一统天下之后，AI的下一张王牌是什么？

extra.evidence: 当所有人都在使用Transformer，多样性为什么仍然重要？ AI发展进入范式收敛期，多位顶尖学者呼吁警惕技术路径单一化风险。圆桌聚焦智能演进的关键驱动力，强调多样性是突破边界的核心策略。 需警惕Transformer主导路线的系统性风险；失败应被纳入AI基础研究的合理成本；AI多样性正从算法层升维至自主学习环境构建。 1956 年，达特茅斯会议为“人工智能”这一研究领域命名。70 年后，当 AI 已经从实验室走向千行百业，一个新的问题摆在研究者面前：如果机器真的能够学习、推理、写代码，甚至参与科学发现，那么未来十年，人工智能还将走向哪里？ 在 ICAAS 2026 首场圆桌对话中，诺贝尔化学奖得主、斯坦福大学教授迈克尔·莱维特，2021 年图灵奖得主杰克·唐加拉，以及数学家马骁、中关村学院何纪言，围绕 AI 的技术路线、产业价值、研究方法和自我进化展开了一场跨越计算机科学、数学与自然科学的讨论。 他们的背景不同，对未来的判断也并不完全一致。但这些讨论指向了同一个问题：当 AI 发展进入新的阶段，什么才是推动智能继续向前的关键？ 今天的 AI 产业正在向大型 Transformer 架构和相似的训练范式收敛。这种集中让技术进步的速度前所未有，但也带来了一个隐忧：如果整个行业都押注同一条路线，一旦这条路线触及边界，我们还能从哪里寻找新的可能性？ 莱维特给出了一个颇具启发性的比喻：面对未知的未来，就应该像一个谨慎的银行家，不要把所有筹码押在同一个地方。杰克·唐加拉也强调，研究者应当探索当前主流路线之外的机会，并接受失败是研究的一部分。 更值得注意的是，圆桌嘉宾认为，AI 研究的多样性本身也在变化：过去更多是算法和任务的多样性，现在是人类解决复杂问题的过程，未来则可能是让 AI 自主学习的多样化环境。 而这种研究范式的变化，也引出了一个更现实的问题：当 AI 从追求模型能力走…

items.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems
items.summary: We present IQuest-Q1, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) agentic foundation model with 320B total parameters (15B activated). IQuest-Q1 is developed through a three-stage process: (1) stable and efficient pre-training, combining Stable SplitNorm, Muon, and muP with a two-stage curriculum whose second stage increases the coding-data mixture, preserving a wide stability margin between safe and optimal learning rates; (2) fine-grained mid-training, expanding the data mixture across domains and formats and progressively extending the context; and (3) multi-scaffold with multi-version post-training, combining SFT, domain-specialized RL, and MOPD across various scaffolds to integrate complementary training signals and strengthen agentic coding capabilities. Furthermore, model merging combines different experts and checkpoints from different stages while mitigating conflicts among their parameter updates. The resulting IQuest-Q1 demonstrates capabilities in both coding and general tasks. We release IQuest-Q1 as an open-source model to support community research and development.

items.title: Different Tasks, Different Timesteps: Temporal Task-Aware Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
items.summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) introduce unique quantization challenges due to their iterative denoising process. In this work, we reveal that quantization sensitivity is both taskand time-dependent, with different downstream tasks exhibiting distinct precision requirements across denoising steps. We further show that these patterns can be predicted without groundtruth labels or task-specific evaluation metrics. Building on these findings, we introduce T 2Quant, a task and time-aware mixedprecision quantization framework that uses a label-free sensitivity signal to optimally allocate activation precision across denoising steps under a fixed bit-width budget. Extensive experiments across three DLMs and six benchmarks demonstrate that T 2Quant consistently improves the average accuracy of existing quantization methods, achieving gains of up to 6.7 percentage points under the same budget.

items.title: Spectral-Spatial Interpretation
items.summary: Post-hoc image explanations usually show where a model looks using spatial heatmaps or indicate which channels matter using global channel scores. These separate views are limiting for multispectral data because channel relevance is often spatially localized and physically meaningful. We introduce Spectral-Spatial Interpretation (SSI), a full-grid attribution method over position-channel players (g,c). For each spatial position, SSI fixes the observed surrounding context, defines a conditional game over the channels at that position, and applies the Shapley value to this local game. The result is a full spectral-spatial attribution matrix rather than a single heatmap or a global channel ranking. SSI has a clear local interpretation. It satisfies Shapley fairness within each position, and aggregating its channel attributions exactly recovers the position-level contextual contrast obtained by replacing that position with the baseline. SSI also differs from context-averaged Owen-style hierarchical accounting, which uses the same position-channel grouping but averages over external spatial coalitions. On HLS Burn Scar, SSI outperforms an MC-Owen estimator across retained attribution metrics while using only about 6% of its evaluation budget. Across CUB-200, EuroSAT, and HLS Burn Scar under both per-channel mean and zero baselines, SSI achieves the best joint deletion and insertion AUC over dense, flat, and rank-1 baselines, yields the strongest spectral hit rates and channel del…

items.title: Muse Glimmer 30B: An On-Device Agentic Model
items.summary: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure. The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion. We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

items.title: Mixing Matters: Evidence Position Bias Across Sequence Mixers in Long-Context Question Answering
items.summary: Long-context models often use answer-bearing evidence less effectively when it appears away from a prompt boundary. We compare this position bias across Transformer, state-space, and hybrid Mamba architectures by moving one gold document through a fixed set of nine distractors. The evaluated Transformers show a beginning advantage that the evaluated state-space models lack, while both families favor evidence near the end. A matched pure-versus-hybrid Mamba comparison points in the same direction but remains statistically uncertain. The family difference appears among models that can answer the task. Transformer primacy reappears on synthetic retrieval, where state-space ceiling prevents a family comparison. A corpus swap within one state-space architecture changes overall accuracy without a detectable change in curve shape. Prompt changes can create or nearly remove a beginning advantage. Position remains decodable across architectures even when response curves differ, and attention concentration near initial tokens covaries with beginning sensitivity in the tested Transformer family. These exploratory results show that effective context use depends on the evaluated architecture family, capability, task, and prompt, without isolating the sequence mixer as the sole cause.

items.summary_zh: 研究比较了 Transformer、状态空间和混合 Mamba 架构在长上下文问答中的证据位置偏差。结果显示，Transformer 在证据靠近开头时表现更优，而状态空间模型更倾向于证据靠近结尾。
